# pve_vm_snapshot_rollback (Action)

Destructive: rolls a QEMU VM back to a snapshot (`POST /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}/snapshot/{snapname}/rollback`). The guest state, disks, and any data written after the snapshot was taken revert to the snapshot point. The action waits for the rollback task to finish.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# DESTRUCTIVE: revert VM 100 and its disks to snapshot "snap1".
# All data written after the snapshot was taken is lost.
action "pve_vm_snapshot_rollback" "rollback_vm" {
  config {
    node = "pve1"
    vmid = 100
    name = "snap1"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The snapshot identifier (upstream `snapname`) to roll back to.
- `node` (String) The cluster node running the VM.
- `vmid` (Number) The VM identifier. Must be between 100 and 999999999.
